notes: TZBTC_USD = TWAP(tzBTC/XTZ) x XTZ_USD. Algebraically identical to a BTC_USD x (tzBTC/BTC peg factor) formulation (peg_factor = TWAP(tzBTC/XTZ) x XTZ_USD / BTC_USD), since XTZ_USD and BTC_USD are already independently derived in CORE; BTC_USD is a reference input, not a tzBTC alias, and is not required by the price formula itself. No fixed peg, issuer assertion, or coordinator-selected haircut. Two independent tzBTC/XTZ pools were verified on-chain via TzKT 2026-09-01, both plain constant-product AMMs (no cumulative-price oracle, same as the USDTZ_USD pools): the native Liquidity Baking CPMM (protocol-level, subsidized by baking rewards; alias 'Sirius DEX') and Quipuswap v1 tzBTC/XTZ. Spot prices agreed within ~0.45% at verification time. tzBTC itself has 8 decimals (KT1PWx2mnDueood7fEmfbBDKx1D9BAnnXitn); the shared constant-product adapter and TWAP math scale for this via each pool's token_a_decimals, distinct from this asset's own 6-decimal USD price precision. Numeric thresholds below are provisional pending liquidity/risk review sign-off.
